title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-04-04

ai_review.summary: Flat, uneven soundboard recording of a classic ’69 show that still delivers an inspired Dark Star and a fiery Other One.
ai_review.review: The performance shines on the open‑minded Dark Star and the high‑energy "That's It For The Other One," with several fans noting the band was “on fire.”  Unfortunately the soundboard capture is inconsistent – volume swings from inaudible to blaring and a 12‑second drum solo is oddly split into its own track, which detracts from listening enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised (especially Dark Star and Other One) while recording quality is criticized for volume fluctuations; weighted average yields a solid but not stellar rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Volume varies wildly from inaudible to blaring, described as a flat soundboard; a 12‑second drum solo is split into its own track, indicating editing quirks.

standout_songs: That's It For The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans highlight a strong second‑half energy with the Dark Star and Other One, though overall set is considered average by some listeners.

band_member_comments.Phil: One reviewer jokes about Phil’s “fart” being given its own track, but no musical appraisal is offered.
band_member_comments.Drums: A 12‑second drum solo was separated into its own track, which some reviewers found odd.
